description: Source-of-truth manifest for UDS bundle versions. Each entry MUST match the package.json version of the artifact directory. Each bundle is released on its OWN org repo (szl-holdings/<product>) — see release_repo. The monorepo no longer cuts combined UDS releases; uds-release.sh still builds + signs + verifies all bundles locally, but the assets are uploaded to the per-product repo's release.
